name: Single-hue total look
summary: One saturated colour carries the whole frame: clothes, props, walls and type share a single hue in a few tints.
how: Choose one hue and fix it as a hex value, for example #E0218A.
Use 3 tints of that hue: a pale, a mid and a deep one.
Keep one neutral (white) and one small contrast colour (sky blue) under 10% of the frame.
Let the hue fill 60% or more of the surface.

origin.note: Set photos of a Barbie film show cars, houses and clothes in one pink.

adoptions.via: Photographs and shop pages from the 2022 Barbie film set dress one pink across clothes, cars and houses.
